verdict.rationale: Nix is CLI-first with no separate UI to fall behind. Its core operations are exposed as scriptable commands: build, develop, run, search, flake new, and env upgrade/rollback. System state is defined declaratively in text files like configuration.nix, so an agent can drive everything the product does. However, there is no formal programmatic API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt. Missing for 10: a documented machine-readable API (OpenAPI/HTTP or library API), explicit documentation of interface parity, and independent corroboration of fully scripted agent use.
